title: Connect Zigbee sensors and switches
summary: Zigbee devices in Zigbee2MQTT and Signal K, through a coordinator on Wi-Fi instead of a USB stick.
description: The Zigbee coordinator runs the Zigbee network on an ESP32-C5 or C6 and hands it to Zigbee2MQTT over Wi-Fi. Zigbee2MQTT knows the devices; a Signal K plugin then maps their values to Signal K paths.
